title: Terminal Basics
description: Everyday shell and git, no tricks

questions.prompt: Which command lists hidden files too?
questions.explanation: `-a` includes entries whose names start with a dot; `-s` shows sizes

questions.prompt: You are in /tmp/work. Where does `cd ..` leave you?
questions.explanation: .. is the parent directory, one level up

questions.prompt: Which of these create a directory?
questions.explanation: touch creates files, and cd only moves you; install -d is the lesser-known one

questions.prompt: Type the command that prints the current directory path.

options: Replaces TODO in every file under src/
Searches for TODO recursively under src/
questions.explanation: -r walks the directory tree; grep never modifies files

questions.prompt: `command_a | command_b` sends command_a's output to command_b's input.
questions.explanation: That is the pipe: stdout of the left side becomes stdin of the right

questions.prompt:
Which redirection APPENDS to a file instead of overwriting it?

```bash
echo "new line" ?? notes.txt
```
questions.explanation: A single `>` truncates first; `>>` keeps what is there and adds to the end

questions.prompt: In git, HEAD always points at a branch.
questions.explanation: A detached HEAD points at a commit directly, which is how checkouts of tags or old commits work

questions.prompt: Which command shows what changed but is NOT staged yet?
questions.explanation: Plain git diff compares the working tree against the index; --staged compares the index against HEAD

questions.prompt: Type the git subcommand that downloads remote changes without merging them.
questions.explanation: fetch updates remote-tracking branches; pull is fetch plus merge
